name: before_1
prompt: This is the full approved UI of a photoreal pedal steel guitar audio plugin. Keep proportions and everything the same: output ONE image, landscape 1536x1024, identical to the input in framing, layout, scale, lighting, colours, the steel guitar, the rug, the top bar, every knob, label, display and the bottom strip. Change ONLY the A, B, C foot-switch pedals and the LKL, LKR knee-lever controls in the bottom deck: give them proper spacing. A, B and C are the same size, evenly spaced with real gaps between them, each centred under its letter and lamp, the group centred in its section. LKL and LKR are mirror images of each other (LKL's paddle toward the left, LKR's toward the right), each centred under its label, the pair centred in its section. This is the BEFORE position: all five at rest, all three lamps unlit. Keep their existing style (black ribbed rubber, chrome), just spaced and mirrored properly.
